symbols.twelve_roads: represent twelve independently located character homelands; not a canonically adjacent route

cover.camera: sweeping epic high-angle travel line toward seven symbolic sunlit gateways, full-bleed landscape montage, 9:16 cinematic scale

lighting_contract.key: low distant golden horizon; sun appears from behind seven symbolic gateways
lighting_contract.fill: cool sky and subtle earth-bounce foreground
lighting_contract.rim: natural warm edge only on distant terrain
lighting_contract.air: regional haze with separately legible biome silhouettes, no new roads implied
lighting_contract.text_safe: upper center low-detail open sky; low glow behind text
lighting_contract.forbidden: new permanent shrine or gate, false geography, overexposed headline
lighting_contract.light_consistency_qa: Each subject must be legible in grayscale with plausible source, fill, rim, atmosphere; typography overlays deterministic; actual full-resolution generated-image QA required.
